definitions.gloss: way of life, way of living, lifestyle
definitions.explanation: The manner in which one lives their life, including values, choices, and approach to existence.

examples.japanese: {自分|じぶん}の{生|い}き{方|かた}を{見|み}つける。
examples.english: To find one's own way of life.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{生|い}き{方|かた}に{感動|かんどう}した。
examples.english: I was moved by his way of life.

examples.japanese: {人|ひと}それぞれ{生|い}き{方|かた}は{違|ちが}う。{何|なに}が{正|ただ}しいかは{一概|いちがい}には{言|い}えない。
examples.english: Everyone has a different way of living. You can't say definitively what is right.

notes:
{生|い}き{方|かた} refers to how someone chooses to live their life, encompassing their values, attitudes, and life choices.

FORMS:
{生|い}きる (to live) + {方|かた} (way, manner) = way of living

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {生|い}き{方|かた}を{変|か}える: to change one's way of life
- {生|い}き{方|かた}を{見|み}つける: to find one's way of life
- {生|い}き{方|かた}に{迷|まよ}う: to be unsure about how to live
- {自分|じぶん}らしい{生|い}き{方|かた}: living true to oneself

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ライフスタイル: lifestyle (loanword, often about daily habits)
- {人生|じんせい}: life (abstract concept)
- {暮|く}らし: daily life, living
